concerns.text: Task T014’s verification references FR-018 (baseline GPU metrics), but the specification only defines FR-017 for baseline GPU metrics. The nonexistent FR-018 makes the verification condition ambiguous and untestable.

Task T002’s verification assumes that `ruff` and `black` are already installed and correctly configured on the runner. No preceding task adds these tools to the environment or updates `requirements.txt`, so the verification step may fail due to missing dependencies.
